scope: First and last available recorded D1 exposures per target; independent peak centroids vs fresh Gaia DR3, native and reprojected. Not validation of golden coadds.

criteria.robust_rms_definition: sqrt(sum(median_offset_axis**2 + (1.4826*MAD_axis)**2)); bias retained; no residual clipping

limitations: Gaussian centroid model is approximate for undersampled asymmetric SPHEREx PSFs.
No distance/radial velocity or observer parallax correction; candidates with absolute parallax >10 mas excluded.
Gaia G<=18 neighbors do not rule out all infrared blends.
No passing-star selection uses the 1.5375 arcsec acceptance threshold.
Representative individual exposures cannot certify all golden coadds.

params.QUERY:
SELECT TOP 5000 source_id, ra, dec, phot_g_mean_mag, pmra, pmdec, parallax, ruwe
FROM gaiadr3.gaia_source
WHERE 1=CONTAINS(POINT('ICRS',ra,dec),CIRCLE('ICRS',133.75921000,-7.24216000,0.18))
AND phot_g_mean_mag <= 18
ORDER BY phot_g_mean_mag ASC
